title: juncus bulbosus f. pygmaeus
intro: Juncus bulbosus f. pygmaeus, commonly known as Pygmy Rush, is a small, perennial plant species belonging to the family Juncaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Juncus bulbosus f. pygmaeus include mucilage, which forms a protective barrier on the mucous membranes, and its ability to stimulate expectoration, helping to relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
